name: Coulomb
blurb: Coulomb is a simple and elegant circuit simulator.
description:
Coulomb is a simple and elegant circuit simulator.

Features:

• Draw arbitrary circuits

• Plot voltage and current of devices against time

• Save/Load circuits

• Dark Mode support

• Beautiful UI

Available Devices:

• Resistor

• Battery

• Current Source

• AC Voltage Source

• Inductor

• Capacitor

• Diode

• Zener Diode

Problems:

• Circuits containing non-linear devices will most probably not be solvable, because
the current backend is not good at dealing with non-linear systems, that's
going to change though.

• Due to the way inductors and capacitors are modeled you can't put two inductors
in series, or two capacitors in parallel, that's also going to be fixed.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
